subject: unistore: Implement the new PD API for GC (#61529)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent within store scope: unistore MockPD now simulates PD’s newer GC state APIs (txn/gc safepoint + GC barriers/internal controller), and gcworker tolerates decreasing-txn-safe-point errors by skipping GC. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, concurrency, compatibility, or runtime/protocol handling; later history up to upstream/master doesn’t show a follow-up fix indicating a missed Blocker/High problem in these changes.
